description: Duplicate a creative with a new name and optionally a new headline, link or call to action (same media). Creatives have no status, so nothing delivers until you attach one to an ad. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token. Use to make a new creative from an existing one with a different name, headline, link or button. Not for the ad itself (snap_clone_ad).

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

call_to_action.description: Button text, for example SHOP_NOW or LEARN_MORE.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

creative_id.description: Creative id. Get it from snap_list_creatives.

headline.description: Headline shown on the ad (Snapchat limits the length).

name.description: Name to give the new item. Shown in Ads Manager.

url.description: Link people go to when they swipe up. Must start with https://.

name: snap_clone_creative
